versions.changelog:
Initial release with AI-focused robots.txt analysis and generation.

- Analyze robots.txt files to detect which AI bots (e.g., GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot) are allowed or blocked.
- Generate custom robots.txt files with easy AI bot toggling and explanatory comments.
- Audit existing robots.txt for completeness, identifying issues and suggesting improvements.
- List 20+ known AI crawlers with details on user-agents, company, and crawler type.
- Output always includes clear formatting and explanations for each section.
